description.en: Two experiments with 80 and 120 undergraduates compared learning science texts. Retrieval practice outperformed studying with concept maps on tests one week later, including inference and concept-mapping outcomes.
description.sr: Prisećanje ranije učenog nije isto što i ponovno gledanje.

try.en: Our adaptation: after learning, hide the example and reconstruct the steps before reopening it for self-checking.
try.sr: Sakrij primer, obnovi postupak, uporedi.

boundary.en: Short texts in laboratory settings; not direct evidence for a quick classroom prediction or architectural software competence. Concept mapping from memory can itself involve retrieval.
boundary.sr: Pogađanje potpuno novog ishoda nije automatski retrieval practice.

source.title: Retrieval Practice Produces More Learning than Elaborative Studying with Concept Mapping

title.en: A phone with a defined job.

description.en: In large introductory physics sections, observers detected no significant distraction difference between mobile polling and dedicated clickers. Active periods were associated with less distraction than passive periods.
description.sr: Vrsta aktivnosti zaslužuje pažnju uz izbor uređaja.

try.en: Our adaptation: brief, purposeful phone interaction followed by a discussion prompt; the screen need not remain the centre of every activity.
try.sr: Telefon služi konkretnom pokušaju, potom se pažnja vraća obrazloženju.

boundary.en: Observational, institution-specific data from 2014–2015; no significant difference does not establish equivalence, causation or absence of distraction today.
boundary.sr: Rad ne dokazuje da telefon nikada ne ometa učenje.

source.title: Requiring Mobile Devices in the Classroom: the Use of Web-Based Polling Does Not Lead to Increased Levels of Distraction

title.en: A question needs an instructional purpose.

description.en: The guide includes digital and low-tech responses, peer discussion, concept checks and confidence questions, with separate suggestions for large classes.
description.sr: Odgovaranje može imati više dostupnih oblika.

try.en: Our adaptation: identical question IDs on the projected page, phone and paper; optional letter cards and private self-checking.
try.sr: Isto pitanje na projekciji, telefonu i papiru.

boundary.en: Guidance is not causal evidence. A static page cannot collect room-wide answers or produce a genuine class distribution by itself.
boundary.sr: Ručni utisak nastavnika nije automatski histogram odgovora.

description.en: The guide recommends advance download or printing, lower-bandwidth notes, accessible document structures, captions or transcripts, and alternative ways to participate when infrastructure fails.
description.sr: Dostupnost uključuje uređaj, vezu i format sadržaja.

try.en: Our adaptation: lightweight text-first HTML, a print view, optional media and a separately tested downloadable version.
try.sr: Osnovno objašnjenje dostupno je i bez filma.

boundary.en: A disruption guide, not a test of our network or accessibility compliance. Printing alone does not accommodate every student; offline availability must be verified.
boundary.sr: Offline i pristupačnost nisu oznake koje se dodaju bez provere.
